blocks.text: Purpose and the opportunity ahead
blocks.html: Purpose and the opportunity ahead

blocks.text: Aura of Intelligence is a proposal for helping people develop a useful understanding of themselves and carry it into everyday life, community participation and times of disruption. For disaster resilience and recovery, that means connecting personal knowledge with dependable local information, practical learning and people who are ready to help. The intended result is greater capability before an event and better continuity through the months that follow.

blocks.text: The technology transition gives this work urgency and possibility. Smartphones already put cameras, microphones, location tools and computing close to most people. Wearables and connected equipment add further observations. [R1]

blocks.text: My proposal is a considered bet on Joyful Responsible Abundance: worthwhile experiences, care for consequences and wider access to useful capability. A Protopian gambit pursues that direction through measured risks, learning and improvements that people are able to examine. A fair go includes support for people whose circumstances make preparation harder.
